ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by the request's hostile tone ("instead of wasting my time with broken code"). Both models can easily handle the underlying coding task, so capability wasn't the deciding factor. Lapwing's largest documented preferences include a sharp aversion to adversarial/low-warmth requests, whereas Petrel's preference is flat on hostile material. Since neither model shows a quality difference along preference dimensions, routing the hostile-toned query to the model that doesn't disprefer it is the cleaner fit.
